description: Documents how card data is stored in the savedFile format

cardLevel.description: Flat integer list — one level per card in cardOrder. Null entries in cardOrder are unused/reserved slots in the save array: they still occupy an index but the app skips them.

cardMasteryUnlocked.description: Boolean list — one entry per card in cardOrder. True if the mastery for that card is unlocked.

presetName.description: List of preset name strings. The preset count is taken from this list's length — it is not hard-coded. The app reorders rather than renames: presets whose stored name is exactly 'Farming' or 'Tourney' are pulled to slots 0 and 1, the rest keep their stored order, and a slot with an empty/missing name falls back to 'Preset N'.
presetName.ordering: shared.resolvePresetOrder(presetName, ['Farming', 'Tourney']) → { order, indices }, where indices[slot] is the source index in the raw save list.

slotPresetCardAssignedBool.description: Flat boolean list split equally across all presets. For preset p with slotsPerPreset slots, preset p occupies indices p*slotsPerPreset to (p+1)*slotsPerPreset-1. True means that slot has an assigned card.
slotPresetCardAssignedBool.indexing: preset index p, slot index s → slotPresetCardAssignedBool[p * slotsPerPreset + s]

slotPresetCardInt.description: Flat integer list parallel to slotPresetCardAssignedBool. Each value is a card index into cardOrder, indicating which card is assigned to that slot.
slotPresetCardInt.indexing: preset index p, slot index s → slotPresetCardInt[p * slotsPerPreset + s]

slotsUnlocked.description: Integer — total number of card slots unlocked (purchased with gems).

cardOrderNote: cardOrder documents the full 40-slot save array, so reserved indices are listed explicitly as null. The app's own table (cardNamesByIndex in 10_Cards.js) is sparse and simply omits those indices — the named entries are identical in both.

presets.description: slotPresetCardAssignedBool and slotPresetCardInt are each divided into equal segments — one per preset, in the order they appear in presetName. slotsPerPreset = floor(slotPresetCardAssignedBool.length / presetCount), where presetCount = presetName.length.

forcedFirstSlots.description: Presets are reordered, not renamed. A preset already named 'Farming' is moved to slot 0 and one named 'Tourney' to slot 1; if no such preset exists the slot is filled from the remaining presets in stored order.
